required_strings.why: mirrors EveryShippedDescriptionNamesTheRangeTheCodeEnforces in rimworld-simple-improve/Tests/MaterialCostFieldTests.cs, which pins MaterialCostField.MinimumMultiplier and MaximumMultiplier over the ten shipped files. Both halves select on either bound and then require both on that one line, so a copy edit splitting '10% to 500%' across two bullets fails here as well as there. The selector used to carry a bare '5%' clause copied from the test, which substring-matched 25%, 35% and 45% and picked an unrelated bullet; issue #26 removed it from both sides in one commit. These are plain containment tests on both sides on purpose: keeping the rule expressible in this engine's language is what makes the two agree by construction. Changing either multiplier means editing this file and that test together.
